Compliance Engineering

Certified Safety Standards

We build and test our access systems defensively to align with global regulatory safety standards, guaranteeing peace of mind on the job site.

OSHA 1910.25 (US Fixed Stairs)

Regulatory Sizing and Structural Directives

The United States Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) enforces strict dimensional limits for fixed industrial stairs to prevent workplace fall incidents. All ModularStep fixed crossovers conform to these requirements:

  • Stair Angle: Configured precisely at 45° to sit within the OSHA-mandated 30° to 50° range.
  • Tread Width: Minimum width is 22 inches (56 cm) of clear space between stringers.
  • Riser Height: Uniform heights between 6.5 and 9.5 inches (16.5 to 24 cm).
  • Load Capacity: Engineered to support at least 5 times the anticipated live load, but not less than a single concentrated load of 1,000 lbs (454 kg).

EN 131 & EN 1004 (European Codes)

Stability, Load, and Material Compliance

In Europe, climbing access equipment is governed by EN (European Norm) directives. ModularStep products are fully certified under EN requirements:

  • TÜV SÜD Certification: Mobile scaffolding (ProTUBE) and safety platforms are tested and certified by TÜV SÜD.
  • Anti-Slip Classification: Treads are certified to meet R13 classification (highest slip resistance) under DIN 51130.
  • Torsional Resistance: Heavy-duty joints prevent structural bending under side loads.

High-Grip Aluminum Treads

Grooved Profiles & Self-Draining Design

Industrial climbing surfaces are frequently exposed to liquids, oils, grease, and chemicals. ModularStep steps feature specialized deep-grooved aluminum profiles that channel fluids away from foot contact surfaces, ensuring maximum grip in harsh conditions.

The alloy used is marine-grade **6061-T6 aluminum**, which provides superior corrosion resistance in maritime, chemical, and wastewater treatment facilities, requiring zero protective painting or maintenance.

Compliance Checklists

  • ✓ Non-sparking material (ideal for oil & gas environments)
  • ✓ 100% recyclable structural aluminum alloy
  • ✓ Double welds on all load-bearing post couplings
  • ✓ Safety toe-board plates preventing tool fall incidents
